title: The school trip
instructions: Öğretmen Mrs Lee ve öğrenci Sam okul gezisini konuşuyor. Uzun bir diyalog; tarih, saat, gerekenler ve fiyata dikkat et.

script.speaker: sam
script.text: Mrs Lee, can you tell me about the school trip?

script.speaker: teacher
script.text: Of course, Sam. We're going to the Science Museum in London on the twelfth of May.

script.speaker: teacher
script.text: No, it's a Thursday. We're leaving school at half past seven in the morning, by coach.

script.speaker: sam
script.text: That's early! When are we coming back?

script.speaker: teacher
script.text: At about six in the evening.

script.speaker: sam
script.text: Do we need to bring lunch?

script.speaker: teacher
script.text: Yes, please bring a packed lunch and some water. There's a café, but it's expensive.

script.speaker: teacher
script.text: It's fifteen pounds. Please give the money and the letter from your parents to me by next Monday.

script.speaker: teacher
script.text: Yes, but you can't take photos in some rooms.

questions.feedback: Sam cuma mı diye soruyor; hayır, perşembe (Thursday).
Sabah yedi buçukta otobüsle (by coach) yola çıkıyorlar.

options: They are not allowed to buy food.
The café is closed on Thursdays.
questions.evidence: There's a café, but it's expensive.

questions.prompt: When must Sam give the money?
options: on the day of the trip
questions.feedback: Parayı ve veli mektubunu gelecek pazartesiye kadar (by next Monday) vermeli.
